text.tspan: A DHCP server and a client on one virtual cable
dnsmasq: DHCP only (--port=0 turns DNS off)
Step 2 first: dhclient writes the DNS server it receives into resolv.conf.
ip netns exec laptop uses /etc/netns/laptop/resolv.conf only if that file exists;
otherwise dhclient overwrites the container's own /etc/resolv.conf.
